title: ProviderCapabilities and HealthStatus
description: What a BrainProvider declares about itself (ADR-0009). Callers branch on these flags, NEVER on provider name — that rule is what makes ADR-0001's provider independence real rather than nominal, and a static check enforces it.

breaking_changes: 1.1.0 (ADR-0039): $defs.HealthStatus is now a $ref to contracts/core/v1/health-status.schema.json rather than a second, incompatible definition. That schema requires `service`, which this one previously forbade, and its `state` enum adds `starting` and `shutting_down`. Breaking in principle; nothing in the repository produced a HealthStatus before this version, so nothing migrates.
compatibility.notes: Adding an optional capability flag is MINOR, but every new flag needs a documented default for providers that predate it, and the default must be the CONSERVATIVE value (false / unsupported). A flag defaulting to true would make an old adapter claim a capability it lacks.

model_digest.description: Content hash where available. Pins evaluation results to an exact artifact (ADR-0013, ADR-0021) — 'llama3:8b' is not a reproducible identifier. Null where the provider publishes none — Ollama tags are not content-addressed.

native_tools.description: True if the provider accepts tool schemas natively. When FALSE the adapter falls back to JSON-schema prompting and MUST set tool_call_reliability to 'degraded' — the caller is entitled to know it is getting the approximation.

structured_output.description: Schema-constrained generation. When false the adapter uses a documented prompt-based fallback with validation and retry.

token_counting.description: False means Usage.input_tokens is estimated. The quota ceiling must then apply a safety margin.

cancellation.description: MUST be true. ADR-0025 makes cancellation non-optional; an adapter that cannot cancel cannot meet the 300 ms barge-in budget and is not admissible.

tool_call_reliability.description: Set from the eval harness (ADR-0021), not self-asserted. 'unreliable' excludes the provider from turns requiring destructive tools.

requires_network.description: ADR-0007. A provider with requires_network=true MUST NOT be selectable at tier L0. The L0 conformance gate asserts this.

languages.description: BCP-47. Must include 'tr' to serve Turkish turns.

HealthStatus.$comment: ADR-0039 item 1. This used to be a second, incompatible definition of HealthStatus — no object could satisfy both it and contracts/core/v1/health-status.schema.json, which names brain_gateway as a producer and calls itself the uniform report for every service and provider. It wins; this is now only a stable name for it.
